name: Warhammer Blood Bowl - The Official Video Game
description:
About This Game

Strap on your boots. Tighten your helmet. 

Then step onto the pitch and prepare to settle your differences the old-fashioned way: with touchdowns, broken bones and a rabid crowd screaming for violence. This is Warhammer Blood Bowl!

The races of the Old World gather on the Blood Bowl pitch to compete in a sport where strategy, luck and spectacular brutality collide. Dodge, pass, blitz, foul and score your way to victory, but remember: on the Blood Bowl pitch, there is always someone waiting to put you in the dirt.

Built on the foundations of Blood Bowl 3 and updated for the latest edition of the official Blood Bowl tabletop rules, Warhammer Blood Bowl brings new tactical possibilities, refined gameplay and two legendary teams to the digital pitch: the ancient Tomb Kings and the noble Bretonnians.

Master the pitch

Position your players carefully, exploit gaps in your opponent's defence and make the most of every opportunity. Throw the ball, dodge through a tackle zone, unleash a devastating Blitz, or send your biggest player crashing through the opposition.

But nothing ever goes exactly to plan. A failed dodge can leave your star player face-down in the mud. A botched block can turn a winning drive into a disaster. And sometimes, the only thing standing between you and victory is a perfectly timed roll of the dice.

Play the latest edition

Warhammer Blood Bowl brings the latest edition of the Blood Bowl tabletop rules to the digital game, introducing updated rules, skills and tactical possibilities for veterans and newcomers alike.

Build your team around the strengths of your chosen faction, develop your players and adapt your strategy as the match unfolds. Every team plays differently, and mastering their strengths and weaknesses is the key to becoming a true Blood Bowl coach.

If you owned Blood Bowl 3, you will receive Warhammer Blood Bowl for free.

Two legendary teams join the fight

The Old World has never been short of trouble, but two new teams are ready to make the pitch even more dangerous.

  • Tomb Kings – Ancient rulers return from the grave to reclaim their glory. Their armies may have crumbled to dust, but their thirst for victory remains very much alive.

  • Bretonnians – Knights, squires and peasants take to the pitch in the name of honour, glory and the occasional extremely violent tackle.

They join an extensive roster of 12 available teams: Orcs, Humans, Dark Elves, Dwarves, Skaven, Chaos Chosen, Elven Union, Nurgle, Imperial Nobility, Black Orcs, Old World Alliance and Chaos Renegades.

Those were the teams available at launch in Blood Bowl 3, while 12 additional teams that were released afterwards are available as DLCs. 

Whatever content you owned in Blood Bowl 3, either complete teams or cosmetic items, you will retain in Warhammer Blood Bowl.

Rumble Bowl: Fast, furious and unforgiving

On top of Classic 11 vs 11 mode, a new mode has been added: the Rumble Bowl! Take to a smaller pitch with 7 players versus 7 and experience Blood Bowl in a more compact, hard-hitting format. With fewer players and less space to hide, every movement matters and every clash can change the game.

Build your squad, adapt your tactics and make every player count as you battle for control of the pitch. Whether you're looking for a fresh challenge or simply want to get straight into the action, Rumble Mode offers a new way to experience the brutal sport of Blood Bowl.

Build your team. Build your legacy

Develop your team, shape your squad and customize your players to make them unmistakably yours. Customize their appearance, armour and emblems, and create a team that will strike fear (or at least some confusion) into the hearts of your opponents.

Just don't get too attached. Careers in Blood Bowl can be spectacularly short.

Compete your way

Whether you prefer to play alone, challenge friends or test yourself against coaches from around the world, Warhammer Blood Bowl offers a variety of ways to take to the pitch.

Play against the AI, compete in online matches, develop your team and rise through competitive play. Build and manage your own leagues, organize competitions with your preferred settings and prove that your coaching skills can survive against the best teams in the Old World.

Features:

  • The latest Blood Bowl tabletop rules: Play with the updated ruleset, including new skills and gameplay changes.

  • 14 playable teams: Choose from the original Blood Bowl 3 factions plus the brand-new Tomb Kings and Bretonnians.

  • Deep tactical gameplay: Position your players, manage risk and exploit every mistake your opponent makes.

  • New Rumble Bowl – Experience Blood Bowl in a new 7v7 format on a smaller pitch, with tighter spaces, new tactical challenges and no room to hide.

  • Develop your team: Build your roster, develop your players and create your own playstyle.

  • Extensive customization: Customize your players, armour, teams, coaches and cheerleaders.

  • Single-player content: Take on the challenges of the Old World and put your coaching skills to the test.

  • Competitive multiplayer: Face coaches from around the world and fight your way up the ladder.

  • League management_ Create and manage your own competitions with customizable rules and settings.

  • Play your way: Compete against other players or the AI in a variety of match and competition formats.

  • Free for owners of Blood Bowl 3
